title: Answering, Meeting, and Three Ways to Play
label: ch:pt-answering-meeting-playing
canDo: I can say that I answer and meet in Portuguese, split meeting between encontrar and conhecer, and choose among the three verbs Portuguese uses for playing — jogar, brincar and tocar.

payoff.summary: The chapter's last lesson closes the set: after the three play verbs the reader produces all five first-person forms in one run - respondo, encontro, jogo, brinco, toco - chooses jogar, brincar or tocar by the kind of playing, and names brincar as the one root of the three that is genuinely unsettled.
